func.func @main(
  %multiply_weight: tensor<16xf32>, 
  %gemm_weight: tensor<16x16xf32>, 
  %gemm_bias: tensor<16xf32>, 
  %group_norm_weight: tensor<16xf32>, 
  %group_norm_bias: tensor<16xf32>, 
  %x: tensor<16x16xf32>
) -> tensor<16x16xf32> {
  // GEMM: y = x @ gemm_weight^T + gemm_bias
  %gemm_weight_T = "stablehlo.transpose"(%gemm_weight) {permutation = array<i64: 1, 0>} : (tensor<16x16xf32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %y_gemm = "stablehlo.dot_general"(%x, %gemm_weight_T) {
    dot_dimension_numbers = #stablehlo.dot<
      lhs_batching_dimensions = [],
      rhs_batching_dimensions = [],
      lhs_contracting_dimensions = [1],
      rhs_contracting_dimensions = [1]
    >
  } : (tensor<16x16xf32>, tensor<16x16xf32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %gemm_bias_bcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%gemm_bias) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 1>} : (tensor<16xf32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %y_gemm_bias = stablehlo.add %y_gemm, %gemm_bias_bcast : tensor<16x16xf32>

  // GroupNorm: num_groups=16, num_channels=16, so each group is 1 channel
  // Reshape to (16,16,1)
  %y_gemm_bias_reshaped = stablehlo.reshape %y_gemm_bias : (tensor<16x16xf32>) -> tensor<16x16x1xf32>
  %zero_f32 = stablehlo.constant dense<0.0> : tensor<f32>
  %mean = "stablehlo.reduce"(%y_gemm_bias_reshaped, %zero_f32) ({
    ^bb0(%a: tensor<f32>, %b: tensor<f32>):
      %s = stablehlo.add %a, %b : tensor<f32>
      "stablehlo.return"(%s) : (tensor<f32>) -> ()
  }) {dimensions = array<i64: 2>} : (tensor<16x16x1xf32>, tensor<f32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %mean_bcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%mean) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 0, 1>} : (tensor<16x16xf32>) -> tensor<16x16x1xf32>
  %y_centered = stablehlo.subtract %y_gemm_bias_reshaped, %mean_bcast : tensor<16x16x1xf32>
  %y_centered_sq = stablehlo.multiply %y_centered, %y_centered : tensor<16x16x1xf32>
  %var = "stablehlo.reduce"(%y_centered_sq, %zero_f32) ({
    ^bb0(%a: tensor<f32>, %b: tensor<f32>):
      %s = stablehlo.add %a, %b : tensor<f32>
      "stablehlo.return"(%s) : (tensor<f32>) -> ()
  }) {dimensions = array<i64: 2>} : (tensor<16x16x1xf32>, tensor<f32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  // Add epsilon for numerical stability
  %eps = stablehlo.constant dense<1.0000000116860974E-05> : tensor<f32>
  %eps_bcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%eps) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: >} : (tensor<f32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %var_eps = stablehlo.add %var, %eps_bcast : tensor<16x16xf32>
  %var_eps_bcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%var_eps) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 0, 1>} : (tensor<16x16xf32>) -> tensor<16x16x1xf32>
  %std = stablehlo.sqrt %var_eps_bcast : tensor<16x16x1xf32>
  %y_norm = stablehlo.divide %y_centered, %std : tensor<16x16x1xf32>
  %y_norm_2d = stablehlo.reshape %y_norm : (tensor<16x16x1xf32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %gn_weight_bcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%group_norm_weight) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 1>} : (tensor<16xf32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %gn_bias_bcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%group_norm_bias) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: 1>} : (tensor<16xf32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %y_norm_affine = stablehlo.multiply %y_norm_2d, %gn_weight_bcast : tensor<16x16xf32>
  %y_norm_affine = stablehlo.add %y_norm_affine, %gn_bias_bcast : tensor<16x16xf32>

  // Swish: x * sigmoid(x)
  %neg_y = stablehlo.negate %y_norm_affine : tensor<16x16xf32>
  %exp_neg_y = stablehlo.exponential %neg_y : tensor<16x16xf32>

  %one_bcast = "stablehlo.broadcast_in_dim"(%one) {broadcast_dimensions = array<i64: >} : (tensor<f32>) -> tensor<16x16xf32>
  %denom = stablehlo.add %one_bcast, %exp_neg_y : tensor<16x16xf32>
  %sigmoid = stablehlo.divide %one_bcast, %denom : tensor<16x16xf32>
  %swish1 = stablehlo.multiply %y_norm_affine, %sigmoid : tensor<16x16xf32>
